title: Verify released piped installation in Terminal.app
text: Source redirects setup input to /dev/tty. Isolated POSIX pipeline tests prove foreground ownership, interruption and suspend/resume cleanup with stubbed installation side effects. The operator approved visible Terminal.app proof combined with these PTY tests on 2026-10-13. Run the released public installer in Terminal.app and retain visible clean-shell proof before closing this verification gap.
